description: This script automates the creation of a styled DMG (disk image) on macOS, including steps such as copying the app bundle, setting background images, configuring Finder window view options via AppleScript, and resizing the image. It uses external tools like hdiutil, PlistBuddy, awk, and AppleScript to perform system operations.
external_files: Assets and resources specific to the app and background images
AppleScript files embedded within the script

methods.name: to_applescript_list4
methods.description: Converts a space-separated list into an AppleScript list format with four comma-separated values.

methods.name: to_applescript_pair
methods.description: Converts a pair of values into an AppleScript pair format separated by a comma.
